title: Southern Song
capsule: The Northern Song (北宋 / Běi Sòng / Northern Song) was founded in 960 when General Zhao Kuangyin usurped the Later Zhou throne and reunified the Ten Kingdoms. With its capital at Kaifeng, it developed a sophisticated civil bureaucracy and commercial economy. In 1127 the Jurchen-led Jin dynasty captured Kaifeng and the emperor in the Jingkang Incident, forcing the court south.
